name: edit-file
description: Tests the edit_file tool by asking the agent to change a specific default parameter value in ShellTool.swift. The maxOutputLength default is 30_000 in the init parameter list at line 46 (at commit b9baf80). The agent must find and replace this value.
task: In Sources/Yrden/Tools/ShellTool.swift, change the default value of maxOutputLength from 30_000 to 50_000. This is in the init method's parameter list where it says 'maxOutputLength: Int = 30_000'.
